title.zh: 【黑客在 Base 网络增发 1900 万枚 THEO，兑换约 176 万美元 ETH】

current_state.zh: An attacker minted 19 million THEO on Base, dumped them for 700.8 ETH (~$1.76M) and bridged the proceeds to Ethereum, sending the token down 92% in 24 hours.
